A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
